curated_vs_raw.claim: This classifier measures membership in the curated-benchmark artifact distribution versus raw generated SWE tasks. It is not expert taste. Closing that gap without human ratings would need an independent taste instrument (frontier-agent discrimination, construction quotas) whose errors are themselves bounded on a fresh human sample.
